title: In the aircraft about 200 meters from a class 8 object, nobody sees it
place_text: Airborne near the El Paso area

tellings.quote: And I know they don't They see, because I was, probably 200 meters away from an 8th class object,

plain: In 2025, while flying near El Paso, James Valor says he was about 200 meters from what his team calls an "8th class object", a high rank on their own scale of UFO sightings, and yet nobody on board saw it. Valor works with Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon UFOs, and he tells Michels he was there. His point is that these objects can sit close by and still go unseen, at least by some people.
